description: Stable fields of a freshly created 7.18 character right after its first world entry. Only fields that must not drift are listed; serials, timestamps and session state are deliberately absent.

volatileFields.SkillBook: the skill granted by GiveAssailOnCreate carries a randomly generated ID; every other field of the book is identical between runs
volatileFields.SpellBook: the spell granted by StarterSpellOnCreate carries a randomly generated ID, exactly as the skill does; every other field of the book is identical between runs
volatileFields.Password: stored as PBKDF2 over a random salt, so the same password hashes to a different string every time; that difference is the point — two accounts sharing a password must not look alike in the files
